---
title: "raisin_river_read"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)

url <- "https://paddlestats.net/json/r/RAISIN/2025/2015"
rr_results <- read_json(url, simplifyVector = TRUE)
rr_results <- as.data.frame(rr_results)
rrbig_tibble <- 
  rr_results |> unnest_longer(results.rank) |> unnest_longer(results.paddlers)
```

```{r}
rrbig_tibble <- rrbig_tibble |> select(results.year, results.boatType, results.bib, results.classId, results.value, results.rank, results.courseId, results.notes, results.paddlers, results.status)

rrbig_tibble

results.year = list(2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)
flow = list(300, 636, 2649, 450, 1300, 1400, 630, 790, 380)

flow = as.data.frame(tibble(results.year = results.year, flow = flow))
```

```{r}
write_csv(rrbig_tibble)
```
